An adult coloring book that is both artistic and scientific, the illustrations inside Wild Oceans Coloring Book show amazing detail and realism!
Inside this coloring book for grown-ups, you'll find some of the very best imagery available today in the field of sporting art. Author Nick Mayer is one of the top fish portrait artists in the world, an award-winning nature illustrator, marine biologist, and adventurer. After a near-death experience in the frigid Bering Sea of Alaska, Nick began pursuing his lifelong dream of becoming a professional artist. With a solid, accomplished background in both biology and fine art, he creates beautifully detailed paintings that truly pay homage to the exotic fish and sea creatures he so deeply admires.
These 32 sea life portraits meet the highest standards of anatomic accuracy and knowledge. Nick knows his subject matter intimately—based on a lifetime of study and pursuit of the various species—and executes at the highest level. But he fills his imagery with artistic qualities as only a fine artist can do. The result is line art designs that are not only technically accurate, convincing, and powerful, but also fresh, spontaneous, and full of life.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Beautiful and Accurate Sea  Life Renditions To Color!
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Lots and lots of pages of accurately depicted sea life to color as you wish, or using the richly colored drawings as a guide or as inspiration.  The artist provides plenty of helpful coloring tips to achieve beautiful results in shading, contrast, depth, and eyes!  This is probably the only chance any human being has to see the beauty in the eyes of fish. The pages are perforated to be easily removed, and are also bleed-through proof.  One of the other things I love about these coloring pages is that it's printed on archival quality and acid free paper, and, even more (!!) it has the Fair Trade Seal of Approval. Not sure what that means exactly, but it seems that the artist and publisher put a lot of thought into making not only a fun and informative coloring book, but also produced it in an ecologically responsible way.
productPageReviews.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on September 17, 2019

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Educational Fun for the Whole Family
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: One common complaint I encounter from fellow colorists is that they want their husbands/fathers/boyfriends/brothers/sons to join the adult coloring ranks, but they can’t find any coloring books that appeals to them. Well, this is the book that fills this void. Of course you don’t have to be a guy to enjoy it. I’m  not a guy, nor am I particularly outdoorsy (unless gardening counts).If you think that marine life is boring or monochrome, think again. There are some wonderfully vibrant species in this book. So, no worries, you’ll get to use your reds, blues, oranges, yellows, greens etc. Or, you can use soft, neutral, earthy or even metallic colors and create some beautiful scallops, seahorses, starfish, oysters etc. Of course you also get to choose from plenty of colorful fish species.Here are the factors that appeal to me particularly, and that I find others of any coloring skill and background will enjoy:The book includes tutorials that are easy to understand, including one on how to do fish eyesThe designs give you a chance to color realistic, lifelike subjects.The pages are perforated for easy removal.You learn something new because of the factoids on the back of each page.The paper is of high quality.You get real-life, color examples of the species on which the drawings are based.You can learn new techniques, or improve upon existing ones.People are always on the lookout for something different and unique, so I find that these words are often overused. In this case, both adjectives are warranted. The main factors that make this book different from most, besides the subject matter, are:- The factoids for each subject appear on the back of the page, so when you remove it and display it in a binder you can see the appropriate fact. -  Most books, if they have any pertaining info, have it printed on the left side of the image on the back page of the preceding design.-  Some of the pages have a separate, removable section on the bottom of the page that includes a color palette suggestion and color exampleHere is a suggestion: Make this book a nice addition for family activity time because you can have everyone pick something, remove their favorite pages from the book, and color away.* I received a complementary copy of this book in exchange for an unbiased review.
productPageReviews.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on October 5, 2016
